:::{#exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision}
#### Hessian contribution of one binary outcome in terms of the precision and deviation

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution,
derive the [Hessian](#def-hessian) contribution $\hess_\iobs(\prob)$
starting from the simplified [score](#def-score) contribution $\score_\iobs(\prob) = \precision \devn_\iobs$ in @thm-bernoulli-score-contribution,
with the [precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision) $\precision = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$
and the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) $\devn_\iobs \eqdef \outvar_\iobs - \prob$.
Both $\precision$ and $\devn_\iobs$ depend on $\prob$, while the observed value $\outvar_\iobs$ does not.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-precision}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\hess_\iobs(\prob)
&= \deriv{\prob} \score_\iobs(\prob)
&& \text{(definition of the Hessian contribution)}\\
&= \deriv{\prob} \paren{\precision \devn_\iobs}
&& \text{(score contribution)}\\
&= \paren{\deriv{\prob} \precision} \devn_\iobs + \precision \deriv{\prob} \devn_\iobs
&& \text{(product rule)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The derivative of the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) is:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\prob} \devn_\iobs
&= \deriv{\prob} \paren{\outvar_\iobs - \prob}
&& \text{(definition of $\devn_\iobs$)}\\
&= \deriv{\prob} \outvar_\iobs - \deriv{\prob} \prob
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= 0 - 1
&& \text{(derivatives of a constant and of $\prob$)}\\
&= -1
&& \text{(subtract)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The derivative of the [precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision) needs the chain rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\prob} \precision
&= \deriv{\prob} \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}^{-1}
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$ as a negative power)}\\
&= \deriv{\prob} \paren{\prob - \sqf{\prob}}^{-1}
&& \text{(distribute $\prob$)}\\
&= -\paren{\prob - \sqf{\prob}}^{-2} \deriv{\prob} \paren{\prob - \sqf{\prob}}
&& \text{(chain rule and power rule)}\\
&= -\paren{\prob - \sqf{\prob}}^{-2} \paren{1 - 2 \prob}
&& \text{(linearity and power rule)}\\
&= -\paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}^{-2} \paren{1 - 2 \prob}
&& \text{(factor $\prob - \sqf{\prob} = \prob(1 - \prob)$)}\\
&= -\sqf{\precision} \paren{1 - 2 \prob}
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting both derivatives back in:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\hess_\iobs(\prob)
&= \paren{-\sqf{\precision} \paren{1 - 2 \prob}} \devn_\iobs + \precision (-1)
&& \text{(substitute the two derivatives)}\\
&= -\precision - \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \sqf{\precision} \devn_\iobs
&& \text{(multiply by $-1$ and reorder the terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
